content: मन्थः [मन्थ्-करणे घञ्] .²1 Churning, shaking about, stirring, agitating; मन्थादिव क्षुभ्यति गाङ्गमम्भः <ls>U. 7. 16</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 3</ls>. .²2 Killing, destroying. .²3 A mixed beverage; पुंसा नक्षत्रेण मन्थं संनीय जुहोति <ls>Bṛ. Up. 6. 3. 1</ls>. .²4 A churning-stick (मन्था also). .²5 The sun. .²6 A ray of the sun. .²7 Excretion of rheum from the eyes, mucus (from the eyes), cataract. .²8 An instrument for kindling fire by attrition. .²9 A spoon for stirring. .²10 A kind of antelope. .²11 A medical preparation of drink; चूर्णे चतुष्पले शीते क्षुणद्रव्यं पलं क्षिपेत् . मृत्पात्रे मन्थयेत् सम्यक् तस्माच्च द्विपलं पिबेत् <ls>Bhāva P.</ls>
